payload.title: Cart checkout payment gateway not available when Razorpay mode is test on production server
payload.body:
## Evidence
`SecretService::razorpayReadyForCurrentHost()` returns false on non-localhost hosts when `razorpay_mode` is not `'live'`. On production, if an admin sets mode to test (or if there's a config error), the Pay Now button at `/checkout` won't render and users see "Online payment temporarily unavailable" instead.

Additionally, the `$hasPaymentGateway` check in `views/public/checkout.php:79` only triggers the payment button when either Razorpay or Stripe is available. If neither is configured, the checkout becomes a dead end with no path to payment.

## Affected paths
- `app/Services/SecretService.php:4-8` — `razorpayReadyForCurrentHost()` logic
- `views/public/checkout.php:75-101` — payment gateway availability check and button rendering
- `app/Controllers/CommerceController.php:149-151` — same check during order creation

## Acceptance
- [ ] Admin can see clear guidance in the admin panel on how to configure Razorpay mode
- [ ] Checkout page shows meaningful error message when payment is unavailable
- [ ] Cart "Proceed to Checkout" link correctly navigates to /checkout
